summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of ARIA AI Executive Assistant (Turkish-language SaaS) completed. Backend API testing: 34/34 tests passed (100%). Frontend testing: Login, dashboard, chat with SSE streaming + natural language task creation, tasks, calendar, CRM, memory, integrations, global search, theme toggle, logout, and mobile responsive all tested successfully.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working perfectly. No _id fields in responses. User isolation working. Session revocation working. Natural language task creation via chat SSE working.

minor_issues.issue: Nav links in mobile drawer may have visibility timing issue after drawer opens (element not visible error when clicking immediately after drawer opens)
minor_issues.workaround: Add small delay after drawer opens before clicking nav items
